claim: Neurons expressing ETHRA include the neuroendocrine cells that secrete CCAP and Bursicon.
source: Neurons expressing ETHRA include the neuroendocrine cells that secrete CCAP and Bursicon.

claim: CCAP and Bursicon-secreting cells are essential at pupal, but not larval, ecdysis.
